column1: # comment: "Universal-event alignments (event/temporal design) \u2014 gmeow:Event + the gmeow:Participation relator + the open gmeow:eventType / gmeow:ParticipantRole / gmeow:TemporalPrecision value vocabularies + the Allen temporal-relation algebra + Duration / RecurrenceRule, supersetting schema.org Event, CIDOC-CRM E5/E7, OWL-Time, the Time Event Ontology (TEO), ISO-TimeML (TLINK/TIMEX3/EVENT), PROV-O, iCalendar, LODE, SEM, BIO / GEDCOM X (the life-event types) and Wikidata BY REFERENCE. VALUE VOCABULARIES: eventType / participationRole individuals are gufo:QualityValue values, aligned to external classes, fact-types and role-properties with skos:closeMatch (a value-to-class/property correspondence), mirroring placeType. An unforeseen type/role is a fresh individual, never a new class or subproperty (Principle 9 \u2014 no overtyping, no role-subproperty proliferation). REIFIED PARTICIPATION: gmeow:Participation is the NameUsage relator idiom; it carries role / period / confidence / provenance / standpoint that schema.org's flat attendee/performer/organizer and OWL-Time's participation-free interval algebra cannot. The flat gmeow:hasParticipant covers the 80% case and projects to the flat targets. TEMPORAL RELATIONS: the 13 Allen interval relations relate gmeow:Event occurrences directly (the ISO-TimeML TLINK / TEO event-event idiom), aligned to OWL-Time interval* (relatedMatch \u2014 OWL-Time relates the intervals) and TEO (closeMatch \u2014 TEO is BFO-grounded like GMEOW). ISO-TimeML is an XML scheme with no canonical RDF namespace, so its TLINK/TIMEX3/EVENT relType/type/tense/aspect STRING enums are documented as value correspondences (see the inline table), not IRI-aligned; its OWL realization IS OWL-Time, aligned here. CONTESTED FACTS: a disputed type, role, date or location is several coexisting gmeow:accordingTo-indexed claims (standpoint module, standpoint facility), never one slot to win; there is no preferredRank / primaryClaim. CANONICAL (no faithful external term): gmeow:temporalPrecision and gmeow:earliestStart / latestEnd fuzzy bounds (related only to CRM E52 P82a/P82b begin/end-of bounds and TEO hasApproximation)."
